rust.title: Rust
rust.summary: Compiled systems language for native services, shared libraries, CLIs, and constrained Wasm workloads.
use_when: You need deterministic reusable core logic
You need native performance or system capabilities
avoid_when: A browser-only UI is the entire product

workers.title: Cloudflare Workers
workers.summary: Request-oriented edge execution; bindings and configured resources belong to the host, not to portable libraries.
use_when: A hosted adapter around portable core logic
avoid_when: General native process or filesystem requirements

wasm.title: WebAssembly (Wasm)
wasm.summary: Portable compilation target used by some Worker and browser environments; host APIs and runtime limits still apply.
use_when: A host supplies a supported Wasm execution environment
avoid_when: Unrestricted native filesystem and process requirements

rapid-rust.title: AgentSam Rapid Rust
rapid-rust.summary: A separately published Rust scaffolder and build/deploy helper for Cloudflare Rust/Wasm projects; deployment remains explicit.
use_when: You want a Rust Worker API, shared-core, signed-request, or data-processing template
avoid_when: You need an unrestricted long-running native daemon
